			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m190_subject_response_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 2 }
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			}
			var:zg361_case_w_state = 5
			NOT = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m190_subject_response }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_response value = scope:zg361_pp_subject_route }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_author value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_version value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_private_ids value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_code value = scope:zg361_pp_subject_route }
		if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_subject_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_disclosure_refused value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_case_w_feedback_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

zg361_pp_m190_resume_after_subject_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m190_subject_response
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			}
			var:zg361_case_w_state = 5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m189_terminal_code = 2 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
			zg361_pp_m190_core_effect = {
				ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_w_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = this
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
				TICKET_STATE = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
			var:zg361_case_w_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 5 }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 190 }
			var:zg361_case_w_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.190 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

			}

				var:zg361_transfer_hc_conserved = 1
				var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver = {
					liege = root
					primary_title.tier > prev.primary_title.tier
					vassal_count < vassal_limit
					NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }

				NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_goal_bundle_id

				var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 1

				var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_subject = this
				var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver
				var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_source_cycle = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_source_cycle
				var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_source_case = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_source_case
				var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_title = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_title
				var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_maturity_cycle = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_maturity_cycle
				var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_position_kind = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_position_kind
				var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_position_kind = 1
				primary_title = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_title
				var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_title = { holder = this }
				var:zg361_transfer_hc_authorized = 1
				var:zg361_transfer_hc_reserved = 1
				var:zg361_transfer_hc_partition = var:zg361_transfer_hc_authorized
				var:zg361_transfer_hc_conserved = 1
				var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver = {
					liege = root
					primary_title.tier > prev.primary_title.tier
					vassal_count < vassal_limit
					NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }
					NOT = { is_at_war_with = prev }
				}
				NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_receiver }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_goal_bundle_id
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m184_support_status
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m187_graduation_status
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m183_subject_statement_code
				var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager = {
					zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = root }

			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {

				var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available >= 1

			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision

			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_w_last_choice

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_cycle

			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 190
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }

			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_route value = 3 }

			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_w_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m190_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_transfer_disclosure value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_transfer_disclosure value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_bundle_id value = { value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial multiply = 1000 add = 190 } }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_acl_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_acl_receiver value = var:zg361_pp_m189_receiving_manager }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_vacancy_id_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_transfer_vacancy_id }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_goal_snapshot value = var:zg361_b2_pip_case }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_support_snapshot value = var:zg361_b2_pip_support_reserved }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_completion_snapshot value = var:zg361_b2_pip_state }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_code }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_receiver value = var:zg361_pp_m190_acl_receiver }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_disclosed_fields value = 4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_private_ids_excluded value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_old_rating_snapshot value = var:zg361_pp_w_non_aggravation_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_old_rating_unchanged value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_acl_pass value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_stigma_risk value = 0 }

					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_external_request_status value = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_external_request_red_code value = var:zg361_transfer_adapter_red_code }
					if = {
						limit = {
							trigger_if = {
								limit = { has_variable = zg361_transfer_adapter_applied has_variable = zg361_transfer_vacancy_status }
								var:zg361_transfer_adapter_applied = 1
								var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 2
							}
							trigger_else = { always = no }
						}
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_acl_pass value = 1 }
						save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject
						var:zg361_pp_m190_acl_receiver = {
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_bundle value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_bundle_id }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_subject value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_cycle value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_case value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_vacancy value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_vacancy_id_snapshot }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_goal value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_goal_snapshot }
							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_support value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_support_snapshot }

							set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_received_transfer_subject_statement value = scope:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_subject.var:zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_snapshot }
						}
					}

				}

				zg361_pp_m190_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m190_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }

	}
}

zg361_pp_m190_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m190_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m190_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m190_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m190_transfer_disclosure
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m190_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m190_transfer_disclosure } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_05_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m190_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m190_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_expected_state value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m190_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2190 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2190 days = 30 } }
	}
}
